Alicia: quick RFC follow-up — we didn't finish the discussion on scale-in grace vs reservation credits. want to land on a simple, auditable heuristic.
Mike: high level: prefer longer grace to avoid churn, but that can waste spot capacity. tradeoffs?
Shay: +1 avoid oscillation. suggest two knobs: grace_window (s) and credit_balance per tenant.
Ravi: what signals do we use to trigger scale-in? gpu_util? queue_length? startup_latency?
Alicia: prioritized signals: 1) sustained <40% GPU utilization on pool 2) per-tenant backlog == 0 for > grace_window 3) no pending prewarm jobs
Yumi: also consider KV cache hotness. if tenant has high cache hit, terminating their worker is expensive.
Mike: agree. maybe use weighted score: score = alpha*util + beta*backlog + gamma*cache_hit. scale-in if score < threshold.
Shay: pseudo:
```
score = 0.6*gpu_util_pct + 0.3*(1 - normalized_backlog) + 0.1*cache_hit
if score < 0.35 and idle_time > grace_window: scale_in_candidate = true
```
Ravi: how do reservations fit? reserved tenants should have soft floor so they never drop below reserved_lookahead.
Alicia: proposal: reservation credits = min(reserved_gpus, floor(pool_size * reserved_ratio)). credits float down on scale-out and are replenished slowly.
Ravi: we discussed token-bucket for burst lanes. config example:
```
burst_tokens: {
  capacity: 100,
  refill_per_min: 10,
  per_tenant_limit: 25
}
```
Shay: token-bucket seems good for fairness. also need a backpressure path: if tokens depleted, return 429 with Retry-After and a hint header `X-RW-Token-ETA`.
Yumi: eviction order: prefer terminating opportunistic nodes, then lowest-cost-tenants, respect affinity. but still need fairness floor for small customers.
Ops SRE: ops note — when we scale-in, mark node with cordon & drain for 30s before dealloc; helps in-flight KV flush.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for pool-autoscaler v2 on cluster-eu-2 :rocket:
Mike: two more concerns: accounting visibility (who consumed credits) and billing alignment.
Alicia: action items:
- prototype token-bucket admission and score-based scale-in (Shay + Ravi)
- expose metrics: tenant_credit_balance, pool_scale_score, prewarm_pending (Mike)
- add eviction/rehome metric for cache-miss penalty (Yumi)
- canary on two non-prod pools and chaos test (Ops SRE)
Shay: timeline: 2 weeks for prototype, 1 week canary, 1 week iterate.
Ravi: ok. i'll draft the config schema and a short sim harness for fairness tests.
Yumi: i'll add the cache-aware eviction metric and a doc note about not evicting tenants with >30% cache hit.
Alicia: thanks all. i'll combine notes and update RFC with the new heuristics + default knobs. ping if you want to pair on sim.
Mike: great, adding to sprint board.
Ops SRE: logging request ids for scale decisions please (trace id header). helps postmortem.
Alicia: noted. wrapping up here :thumbsup:
